ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the recent Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota and explore the larger issue at play
ideas.angle: Follow the money and explore the connections between entities and individuals involved in the fraud cases
questions: What are the common patterns and connections between the entities and individuals involved in the Medicaid fraud cases?
How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: The recent Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota suggest a larger issue at play. Further investigation is warranted to explore the connections between entities and individuals involved and to determine the scope of the problem.
